title: Sch9's Role in Sphingolipid Metabolism Regulation
summary: This cluster revolves around the protein kinase Sch9, which is a key regulator of Sphingolipid metabolism. Research by Swinnen E has focused on Sch9, highlighting its importance in this process. The study, published in PMC3873890, provides further insight into Sch9's role. The cluster also includes organisms such as Swinnen E, Accardo S, and others, who may be involved in the research or related to the process of Sphingolipid metabolism.
